statement.excerpt: At some point, the cost of doing business with Anthropic and OpenAI will kill AI startups, as there is no point at which any of them become sustainable, which will in turn kill the revenue from selling access to their models.
statement.document_title: The Subprime AI Crisis Is Here

from_speaker: the cost of doing business with Anthropic and OpenAI will kill AI startups
no point at which any of them become sustainable
in turn kill the revenue from selling access to their models
our_interpretation: The context identifies AI application startups dependent on these companies' paid models, rather than every company using AI.
The ordinary reading predicts broad business failure caused by model costs, followed by collapse of the associated model-access revenue at both labs.
Sustainable means an ongoing business able to cover its costs, including model costs, without continual funding of operating losses. Positive gross margin alone is insufficient.
The predicted causal sequence is part of the forecast, not a separate conditional antecedent.
No financial accounting basis is stated. The contract therefore records it as unknown rather than imposing GAAP or a press-estimate basis.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish broad failure of the relevant startups because of model-access costs, followed by collapse of the labs' associated model-access revenue attributable to those failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified durable sustainability of an in-scope model-dependent startup would refute the universal assertion that none can become sustainable. Temporary revenue growth or positive gross margins alone would not settle the forecast.
